organizationId.description: ID of the contact center organization. It is required to define for the following operations - All bulk save operations

id.description: ID of this contact center resource. It should not be specified when creating a new resource. However, it is mandatory when updating a resource.

version.description: The version of this resource. For a newly created resource, it will be 0 unless specified otherwise.

name.description: A name for the Global Variable.

description.description: A the description for the Global Variable created.

active.description: Indicates whether the Global Variable is active or not.

agentEditable.description: Indicates whether the Global Variable is editable in the Agent Desktop by the agent or not.

variableType.description: A valid Global Variable Type. The valid types are: String, Integer, DateTime, Boolean, Decimal.

defaultValue.description: A default value for the Global Variable.

reportable.description: Indicates whether the Global Variable is reportable or not.

agentViewable.description: Indicates whether the agent can view the Global Variable in Agent Desktop or not.

sensitive.description: Indicates whether the Global Variable is sensitive or not.

desktopLabel.description: A desktop label for the Global Variable created.

systemDefault.description: Indicates whether the created resource is system created or not

createdTime.description: Creation time(in epoch millis) of this resource.

lastUpdatedTime.description: Time(in epoch millis) when this resource was last updated.
